description: The file defines the PollingState interface for managing polling states within an ECU communication manager, including getters and setters for various state flags and information.

classes.name: PollingState
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing polling state in ECU communication

methods.name: isNewQuery
methods.description: Checks if the current state is a new query.

methods.name: setNewQuery
methods.description: Marks the state as a new query or not.

methods.name: isLastQuery
methods.description: Checks if the current state was the last query.

methods.name: setLastQuery
methods.description: Marks the state as last query or not.

methods.name: isFastPoll
methods.description: Checks if the polling is in fast poll mode.
